name: Pulse Branding
heading: A point of view, made visible.
intro: The agency identity frames the collection. Midnight blue, a cool light ground and a measured contrast between Montserrat and italic Noto Serif Display follow the current website.
sourceLabel: Open the existing Pulse Branding center
basis: Existing Notion Brand Center (2023), unchanged 2025 logo master and the current www.pulse-branding.com homepage inspected 7 September 2026. Colours below are verified website values.
notes: The public /brand-center page returned Page Not Found. The older center includes Gotu and Tenor Sans, whereas the live homepage uses Montserrat with Noto Serif Display italic. An AI-maintained 2026 bible contains conflicting HEX/RGB pairs; it is not treated as an approved replacement. These versions are kept separate.
application: The collection’s introduction and agency reference use this current website identity. Each client’s case remains in its own visual language.

name: NeoLabCare
heading: Precision, with a human voice.
intro: The identity is more than a black bottle. A custom wordmark, a warm near-black palette, carefully weighted sans-serif type and a contrasting serif form a complete visual language.
basis: Logo downloads, colour system and typography sections of the live brand book, checked 7 September 2026. This replaces the earlier incomplete brand-source search.
notes: The book's logo section and later download section differ on minimum size and primary variant. This display follows the download section's gold-on-dark usage and the stricter 120px minimum. It does not copy the book's inconsistent product or efficacy claims. Typography specimens follow the identity table; the website's separate CSS table specifies 600-weight interface labels and 400-weight body text.
colorRule: Colour specimens are reference chips, not suggested page fills. Sand Gold is reserved for accents, rules and typographic emphasis. Crimson #C1121F belongs to physical applications only; it is not a digital accent.
application: Packaging, the product image system and the original motion study follow below. Historical artwork remains labelled as development, rather than silently treated as current production approval.

name: Robotist
heading: An identity with room to breathe.
intro: A precise wordmark, widely spaced typography and an ocean-blue hierarchy give the robotics brand a recognisable voice before a product is introduced.
basis: Recovered robotist-brand-system/robotist-brand-guide.html. The live site's system-font implementation is recorded separately; it does not replace the guide's Poppins typography.
notes: A public brand-center URL is not yet verified. This is a portfolio reference assembled from the recovered guide, not a newly approved client brand book.
application: The character system, product presentation and digital applications show how this identity behaves beyond the logo.

name: Vodkiss
heading: An expressive family, not a single label.
intro: The original wordmarks, five-colour palette and three type families connect identity, botanical illustration and packaging.
basis: Pulse Branding – Vodkiss Brand Identity and Packaging Design.pptx, identity palette and typography on slides 19–20.
notes: No standalone public brand-center URL is verified. Type-family assignments in this portfolio are presentation adaptations, not a claimed approved website type scale.

type.sample: Flavour, with a sense of occasion.

application: The flavour labels, botanical worlds, gift packaging and flat production artwork are the identity in application.

name: WeKwikGene
heading: A shared language for science.
intro: The combined Westlake / WeKwikGene lockup, scientific colour hierarchy and Alibaba Sans are presented as one system, alongside the original DNA visuals.
basis: WeKwikGene Case Study 2024.pptx and the recovered original logo package. The original case-study palette is retained.
notes: A public brand center is not yet verified. Live website aqua and orange differ slightly from the 2024 deck. They are documented as implementation differences, not silently normalised into the historical case.
application: The original case contains logo, colour, type, DNA motion and platform applications. Its established composition and motion remain intact.

name: GramLingo
heading: Learning has a visual personality.
intro: A warm sunset palette, rounded display lettering and the original Gramlin build recognition across the landing page and learning worlds.
basis: Original landing-page logo, served fonts and colours. This reference records the current source identity; it is not a substitute for a separately approved brand book.
notes: The dedicated brand-center location remains unverified. App typography variations stay visible in the unaltered source screenshots. Native-app release is not implied.

type.sample: One question. A world to explore.

application: The original Gramlin poses, world covers, landing page and mobile learning screens demonstrate the wider identity.

name: Ancient Science of China
heading: A mark. A script. A field of knowledge.
intro: The cinnabar mark, warm paper, brown ink and contrasting Latin and Chinese typefaces establish the catalogue's identity.
basis: The user-confirmed domain and its observed ancient-science-of-china-n9pv.onrender.com deployment. Original asoc-mark-cinnabar.svg, served colours and fonts.
notes: The dedicated brand center and current source checkout remain unverified. The rejected Astro project and its deployments are not sources for this reference.
application: The catalogue, field navigation and desktop and mobile pages show this visual language in use.

name: BrainyBaobei
heading: A recognisable point of view.
intro: The original mark, ink landscapes, portrait studies, warm grey paper and pink create a personal identity around the reading experience.
basis: Original supplied artwork and the current website's Philosopher / Mulish type system and core palette. The five-element colours in the case are semantic reading colours, not replacements for the brand palette.
notes: A separate brand-center URL is not yet verified. Only the public fictional sample is used for reading screenshots; no personal reading is included.
application: The portrait, ink landscape, landing page and mobile reading belong to the same brand story.

name: Pulse Growth Engine
heading: The product's own identity.
intro: The current application combines a dark workspace, a blue-to-violet accent system and Geist typography. This product identity is distinct from Pulse Branding and from Pulse Instinct.
status: Working product identity · brand master pending
basis: Current Home.tsx and index.css. The displayed Sparkles symbol preserves the existing interface component geometry; it is not presented as a commissioned custom logo master.
notes: A dedicated Growth Engine brand center and approved custom logo package remain unverified. The product's Brand Kit feature manages other brands; it is not evidence of Growth Engine's own brand guidelines.

logos.label: Current interface symbol / not a custom logo master

type.sample: A source. A decision. A next step.

application: The current entry screens and explicitly dated workflow captures show digital applications; neither establishes an approved brand-book release or a working publishing integration.

name: Pulse Instinct
heading: A response, with a recognisable form.
intro: The original silhouette brings a mind, the initials P and I, and a bullseye into one mark. Its gradient, custom lettering and Poppins typography carry through the preference-testing experience.
sourceLabel: Open the original Pulse Instinct Design Guide
basis: Pulse Instinct 2022.pptx, especially slides 3–7, and the September 2022 Notion Design Guide. Original embedded PNG artwork is extracted without alteration. The five core colours below come from slide 7.
notes: The Notion Brand and Logo library is at https://app.notion.com/p/21674b62a5e04443835010dfd67e5458. The current app login retains Poppins, navy and violet but includes a teal-to-violet button gradient; it is a separate current implementation. The 2022 mobile designs are archival mockups, not current app captures. Pulse Instinct / 心动挑挑 is separate from Pulse Growth Engine.
colorRule: The Design Guide specifies supplied gradients only, with 45-degree direction for buttons and horizontal direction allowed on scrolling pages. Original gradient artwork is preserved in the images and films; the five-colour plate is not used to invent a replacement gradient.

type.role: Supporting identity family / Medium 500 presentation specimen
Supporting identity family / Regular 400 presentation specimen

application: Original welcome and preference-testing mobile designs, onboarding artwork and recovered logo and promotional films show the 2022 identity in application.

name: Edenne
heading: Warmth, held in a system.
intro: The supplied heart/flame and custom wordmark lead a day-and-night identity. They are original design exports, never approximated with typed text.
sourceLabel: Open the local Edenne brand center
basis: Edenne logo 20260907.ai and the local brand-center exports. Day and night variants are recorded as the current prototype system, not a public product launch.
notes: The brand center is local and will not be accessible to external portfolio viewers. Its display and body families are Trebuchet MS and Verdana; character and scene fonts remain as captured in original artwork.

type.sample: The same welcome, closer to hand.

application: The day/night boards, app icon, companion welcome and garden prototype carry the identity into its intended contexts.
